views.markdown: Makes the **8BitDo Ultimate MGX** work as a normal game controller.

iOS already pairs the MGX as a BLE HID device and matches it in the GameController database by VID/PID, but skips its mapping on a personality version check:

```
Personality definition requires version '11.4.7'
did not find a compatible personality
```

The MGX mapping ships in a downloaded GameController database asset newer than the running GameControllerFoundation, which is why iOS 18.5 added support.

MGXFix patches the compatibility field and selects the Default personality **in memory** as the plists load. Nothing on disk is modified.

- Only `GameControllerConfigService` is hooked.
- Applies on the next controller connect; no respring needed.
- Verified on iOS 17.1.1 (iPhone 13 Pro, roothide).

- The MGX mapping is now bundled with the package instead of relying on a downloaded GameController database asset. On devices whose asset predates this controller the tweak previously found nothing to patch and did nothing.
- Adds the device entry itself when the installed database has no `com.8BitDo.UltimateMGX.Bluetooth`.
- Logs explicitly when the iOS release predates the personality system, instead of failing silently.

- Initial release.
- Patches the GameController personality version gate so the MGX mapping loads.
- Forces the Default personality (WithBackButtons expects paddles the base MGX does not report).
